description: Runs a fixture-backed Web-platform semantics probe for IndexedDB version upgrade migration + index. The driver reads output from the self-hosted fixture `/fixtures/l2_round3/dB_h_idb_upgrade.html`, and the server-side grader compares it with the checked-in expected answer. Current probe details: IDB async two-phase (v1 write, close, v2 upgrade+index); PENDING pattern; timeout 9s in plan; output 'VIP_AFTER_UPGRADE=2:ANN,CAM'.
title: IndexedDB version upgrade migration + index
